use_case_summary: In-app conversational help for paying enterprise customers + embedding-based product search. Need low-latency chat (interactive support) and cost-efficient reranking/embeddings for search indexes.
hosted_trial_results: Trial window: 2026-02-02 -> 2026-02-17; 72-hour focused replay + 2 week lightweight usage
Observed steady-state QPS: 4.8 QPS (avg) across business hours (NA region)
Observed peak QPS: 22 QPS (10-minute sustained spike, reported during onboarding flows)
Avg concurrent requests during peak: 18 concurrent in-app sessions (backend parallelism 12 avg)
Token mix (by request count): 60% short (<256 tokens total), 30% mid (256-1024), 10% long (>1024)
Average tokens per request: 480 tokens (230 prompt / 250 generation split avg)
p50 latency (hosted): 48 ms per token; p95 latency: 220 ms per token for generation paths on baseline model (redwood-compat small-v1)
Error rates: <0.2% 5xx; few transient timeouts at peak — product noticed visible slowdowns at sustained >15 QPS
Unit cost observed (hosted): $9.8 per 1000 generation tokens (trial billing model) — customer flagged potential OPEX pressure at scale
dedicated_sizing_estimate: Target production SLOs: p95 end-to-end latency <250ms for 512 token gen; target safety: 99.9% availability
Traffic forecast (12-month rolling): baseline 6 QPS -> growth to 35 QPS (Q4) with spikes to 80 QPS during peak campaigns
Concurrency sizing (expected): steady concurrency 20-30, peak concurrency 80+; recommend headroom factor 1.5x on peak
Model mix & optimization: prefer quantized 4-bit variants for reranking/embeddings; reserve fp16 for chat-critical flows
Suggested Dedicated footprint: 4x high-memory GPU nodes (baseline) with autoscale burst to 6 nodes for traffic spikes — equivalent to ~4-6 GPU units depending on instance type
Batching config: target average batch window 25ms for chat, longer batch windows for embeddings jobs to lower unit cost
Expected monthly committed cost (estimate): $35k - $65k / month depending on GPU SKU and committed term; estimated ARR uplift if committed: 50k-120k ARR tier
Fallback policy recommendation: primary region + cross-region failover + warm standby node for enterprise customers
Operational items: need tracing hooks + per-route token breakdown (console) and alerting on KV cache hit ratio for cost savings
